notes.title: Take Control of Your In-Game Audio Experience
notes.notes:
Dear Life Changer Players,

We are thrilled to announce the latest update for Life Changer, aimed at enhancing your gaming experience like never before. We have listened to your feedback and are excited to introduce Music and Sound volume buttons in the game menu. Now, you have the power to fine-tune your audio settings according to your personal preferences.

In this recent update, we have incorporated Music and Sound volume controls, allowing you to adjust the settings with ease. Whether you want to create a serene atmosphere by muting the Music, or dial up the intensity with the perfect Sound volume, it's all in your hands. Simply drag the music volume bar to 0 for a blissfully silent experience, or adjust the Sound volume to achieve your desired level of immersion.

To access these exciting new features, simply update your game to the latest version. Thank you for your continued support, and we look forward to hearing your feedback on this latest update.

Happy gaming!

The Life Changer Team

notes.title: Life Changer: New Difficulty Modes Available
notes.notes:
Dear Life Changer Gamers,

We're excited to announce that the Life Changer game has just been updated with a brand new feature: AI difficulty settings for Single Player mode! Now, you can choose between Easy, Normal, Hard, and Insane difficulty modes to tailor your gaming experience to your liking.

Please note that after updating the game, old save games will no longer work. So, if you want to continue with your previously saved game, we recommend not updating the game until you finish it. However, if you've already updated the game and want to load your old save game, don't worry, you can still do so by following these steps:

1. Go to Steam - Settings - Properties - Betas
2. Change to the previous version
3. Load your old save game

We hope you enjoy this new feature and we can't wait to see you back in the game!

Best Regards,

Life Changer Team

notes.title: Life Changer Graphics Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear Life Changer players,

We're excited to announce that we have improved the graphics options for the game. Full-screen mode can be toggled directly at the windows screen now and no longer degrades graphic quality in Life Changer. This will provide a more immersive gaming experience and allow you to enjoy the game in all its visual glory! Update your Life Changer game now to enjoy the improved graphics in full-screen mode!

We're always striving to make Life Changer the best game it can be, and we hope this improvement will enhance your gameplay experience. As always, we welcome your feedback and suggestions on how we can continue to improve the game.

Thank you for your continued support, and we hope you enjoy the updated graphics options in Life Changer!

Best regards,
The Life Changer Team

notes.title: Life Changer Update: Improved AI and University Graduation Rewards
notes.notes:
Greetings Life Changer players! 

We are thrilled to announce our latest update, which brings improved AI and new rewards for university graduates.

In the latest version of the game, you'll face an even greater challenge as you take on the new and improved AI. We've made significant improvements to the AI system, making it more difficult to defeat. Are you ready to test your skills and take on the challenge? Update your game now and see if you have what it takes to win.

In addition to the AI improvements, we've also made some changes to the university graduation system. Now, every time you graduate from the university, you'll receive a one-time significant happiness boost. We believe that education is key to achieving happiness in life, and we're excited to reward our players for their hard work and dedication.

So what are you waiting for? Update your Life Changer game today and experience all the exciting new features. Thank you for playing, and we can't wait to see you in the game!

notes.title: Leave Button Disappearing Issue
notes.notes:
Dear Life Changer gamers,

We are happy to announce that we have fixed the issue where the Leave button was disappearing after working at the Clinic and Gym in Life Changer. We know that this bug was frustrating for many of you, and we apologize for any inconvenience it may have caused.

To obtain the fix, please make sure to update your game to the latest version. Once you have updated, you can continue your journey in Life Changer without any interruptions. We appreciate your patience and support as we worked to resolve this issue.

We are committed to providing you with the best possible gaming experience, and we value your feedback. If you encounter any other issues or have any suggestions for improvements, please do not hesitate to reach out to us.

Thank you for playing Life Changer, and we hope you enjoy the game!

Best regards,

Life Changer Team

notes.title: Game Update Alert: Full Screen Mode Now Available!
notes.notes:
Dear Life Changer Game Players,

We have some exciting news to share regarding the window size of our game. Thanks to your valuable feedback, we have implemented a full screen mode in the latest update of the game.

To activate this new feature, all you need to do is press the Alt+Enter keys on your keyboard. This will toggle the game between full screen and windowed mode, allowing you to enjoy an immersive gaming experience.

We recommend updating your game to the latest version to take advantage of this and any other improvements we may have made. To update your game, please check for updates in your Steam library and follow the installation instructions.

We hope that this change will positively impact your gaming experience and we welcome any feedback you may have. Your continued support means the world to us, and we look forward to hearing from you soon.

Thank you for playing our game and happy gaming!

Best regards,

Life Changer Team

notes.title: Game Update Alert: New Volume Control Feature!
notes.notes:
Dear Life Changer Game Players,

We are excited to announce that the latest update of our game includes a new feature that we believe will significantly enhance your gaming experience. With this update, we have implemented volume buttons in the game menu.

We understand that volume control is a critical aspect of the gaming experience, and we are thrilled to provide you with the ability to control it effortlessly within the game menu. This feature is now available for existing players, who can update their game to access this new function.

We want to express our gratitude for your continued support, which has made it possible for us to introduce new features that help to improve your gaming experience. We hope that this latest addition will bring you even more enjoyment and satisfaction while playing our game.

Thank you again for your loyalty and dedication to our game. We look forward to hearing your feedback on this new feature.

Best regards,

Life Changer Team
